name: paper-deep-reader
title_zh: 读论文先重建问题再记笔记，每句都标页码出处
tagline_zh: PDF 或链接丢进来，还你一份带术语表、公式推导、实验设计与局限性的飞书笔记。每个论断都钉在原文页码上。
tagline_en: Drop a PDF or link, get Feishu-ready notes with glossary, derivations, experiment design, and limitations—every.
desc_en: Deeply read academic papers and produce source-grounded, Feishu-ready learning notes. Reconstructs the research problem, terminology, notation, method pipeline, key equations, worked example, experimental design, claim-evidence links, contributions, limitations, and research context. Use for uploaded PDFs, paper URLs, preprints, journal articles, conference papers, technical reports, and requests
why_zh: 它不摘抄，而是先重构研究问题与符号体系，再沿方法管线逐段核对公式与实验设计。
why_en: It doesn't excerpt—it reconstructs the research question and notation first, then traces the method pipeline against equations.
limit_zh: 只吃学术文本：PDF、预印本、期刊/会议论文。教科书章节、专利、技术白皮书会硬套论文骨架，产物可能失真。
limit_en: Academic texts only: PDFs, preprints, journal/conference papers. Textbooks, patents, whitepapers get force-fitted and may distort. Needs network for.
title_en: Paper reader that rebuilds the problem, then notes with.
